verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly claim enhanced AV1/H.265 (HEVC) encode support with improved quality and new 4:2:2 encoding, positioning it for livestreaming and real-time editing (creator-media use case). However, there is no mention of ISV certification programs (e.g., NVIDIA RTX/Quadro ISV certification for Adobe, Autodesk, etc.) or specific creator-app acceleration partnerships, and no independent corroboration of encoder quality/performance claims. Missing for 10: ISV-certified driver documentation, named creator-app certifications, and independent hands-on verification of encoder claims.
